notes:
Refines the Custom Site Settings layout with smaller section headings and removes the separately displayed M3U/EPG URLs while keeping them linked to the Simple IPTV actions.

Extends the once-per-Kodi-session IPTV update check to legacy Play_COM, Play_OXAX, Play_CLICK and Play_FUCKFLIX playlist links so existing m3u4u entries are still covered.

Improves Simple IPTV Prüfen by redirecting legacy Play_* entries to the dedicated PVR_* resolver path during the test, preventing overlapping self-starting players and false instant-success results.

Requires a real, briefly stable playback state before a tested IPTV channel is counted as successfully started.

Reduces the standard first-attempt Adult-TV-Channels.com warmup from 2.2 seconds to 0.7 seconds while preserving the longer warmup for known slower channels and retry attempts.

Normal Custom Site playback, playlist generation, thumbnails, Landscape Wall support and update behavior remain otherwise unchanged from v1.90.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
